_comment: Rate-limit policies (spec §5). global applies to every account; accounts.<name> overrides per account. interval = minimum seconds between actions; jitter = [min, max] random extra pause. Floor: 1.5s/action enforced everywhere. lane: server-wide SEQUENTIAL sends — every outbound action (all accounts) goes one-at-a-time, spaced by prefixrate; 0 pauses the lane.
